lead_raw_text:
The structure of Lu₂Ga₂Au₂ (LuGaAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216) with a unit cell containing 24 atoms—8 Lu, 8 Ga, and 8 Au—distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows all three elements adopt close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors per center atom: Au is surrounded by 4 Ga and 8 Lu, while Ga and Lu each have 8 Au and 4 Ga or Lu neighbors, respectively, all within 2.9558 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 24 sites, and validated polyhedron contacts include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing between Au and Ga polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Au and Lu polyhedra.
